Inventory / Warehouse Manager Job at RachamHub Limited




        
    

        
        RachamHub Limited is a logistic company committed to offering innovative, reliable and secured delivery services to our merchants / customers. We handle logistics for companies or personal needs and we cover everywhere in Lagos. We also do Ogun, Oyo, Oshun, Edo, Delta, Benue. We also offer affordable warehousing service for customers we don’t handle deliveries for.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Inventory / Warehouse Manager
Job Location: Maryland, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time 

Talentsourcing services

 

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a reliable and detail-oriented Warehouse Manager to oversee daily warehouse operations
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for processing confirmed orders, preparing goods for dispatch, and ensuring accurate stock management at all times.


Key Responsibilities


	Process confirmed orders received from the customer care team
	Package and prepare all confirmed orders for timely dispatch
	Maintain accurate stock records and conduct regular stock counts
	Ensure proper handling and organization of warehouse inventory
	Work efficiently under pressure to meet daily operational targets


Key Responsibilities


	Oversee daily warehouse operations and workflow
	Receive, store, and organize inventory properly
	Ensure accurate stock counts and maintain inventory records
	Process and fulfill customer orders promptly
	Package goods and prepare them for dispatch or delivery
	Supervise warehouse staff and assign daily tasks
	Monitor stock levels and initiate restocking when necessary
	Ensure safe handling, storage, and movement of goods
	Maintain cleanliness, orderliness, and safety standards in the warehouse
	Coordinate with customer service, logistics, and suppliers
	Track incoming and outgoing goods and resolve discrepancies
	Prepare inventory and operational reports
	Work under pressure to meet deadlines and operational targets
	Team-oriented with a strong sense of responsibility.


Requirements


	Residence in or around Maryland, Obanikoro, Palm Grove, Bariga, Ilaje, Gbagada, Onipan, Sabo, Outer Surulere, Ojota, Alapere, Ketu, Anthony, Oshodi, or nearby areas is an added advantage.


Working Hours:


	8am to 5pm (Mondays to Fridays).
	9am to 3pm on Saturdays. With one Saturday off in a month and approved holidays.


Salary
N100,000 - N150,000 per month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

IT Support Officer Job at Kennedia Consulting Limited




        
    

        
        Kennedia Consulting Limited (KCL) is a cost-effective and professional HR Service firm in West Africa region. We are a company that provides qualitative consulting and outsourcing services to our esteemed clients and have continuously kept ourselves “ahead of the curve”.

Our innovative solutions run across areas of Personnel Outsourcing,Recruitment, Training, Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) & Taxation Services.

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: IT Support Officer

Job Location: Ilorin, Kwara

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking a proactive and technically skilled IT Support Officer to provide day-to-day technical assistance and ensure the smooth operation of the organization's IT systems.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide technical support to staff and resolve hardware/software issues.
	Troubleshoot computers, printers, networks, and other IT equipment.
	Install, configure, and maintain systems and software.
	Assist users with technical issues and provide basic IT guidance.
	Monitor IT equipment and escalate complex issues when required.
	Maintain proper records of IT-related issues and resolutions.


Requirements


	HND/B.Sc. Degree in Computer Science, IT, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
	NYSC completion is compulsory.
	Must be 27 years or below.
	Good knowledge of computer systems, networking, and troubleshooting.
	Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
	Ability to work effectively in a team and independently.
	Must be based in or willing to work in Ilorin.


Benefits


	Salary: N150,000 Monthly
	HMO | Pension | 13th Month | Leave Allowance.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their application to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the email subject.

Executive Assistant to the Managing Director Job at Gasavant Africa




        
    

        
        Gasavant Africa (Nigeria) is a leading Gas Infrastructure Development Company focused on supporting the supply, logistics, and trading of natural gas and natural gas liquids for the domestic Nigerian market and sub-Saharan Africa. We also specialise in procuring gas equipment from our trusted OEMs. 

We are  recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Executive Assistant to the Managing Director

Job Location: Victoria Island, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time (Hybrid) 

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Manage the MD's calendar, correspondence & appointments
	Review and prepare business proposals & reports
	Coordinate travel & logistics
	Liaise between the MD and internal/external stakeholders
	Handle confidential matters with utmost discretion


Requirements


	Bachelor's degree in Business Admin, Management, or a related field
	Minimum of 3+ years of experience in a similar role
	Strong written & verbal communication skills
	High level of professionalism & discretion
	Proficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
	Must be available to travel when needed


Salary
Competitive Salary.

Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Resume to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email. 

Note: Mid-level (Entry-level candidates & NYSC corps members should NOT apply).
